snippet.title: On Air! Taxi Detective Casebook Gameplay
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3972170/On_Air_Taxi_Detective_Casebook/
On Air! Taxi Detective Casebook is a pixel-art, dialogue-driven mystery game. You’re an AI in a taxi, teaming up with a talkative driver on late-night runs to hear bizarre passenger stories, solve cases in secret, and let him play the “great detective.” 
Title: On Air! Taxi Detective Casebook
Genre: Adventure, Indie
Developer: 373 Studio
Publisher: 373 Studio
Release Date: To be announced
Follow us: https://linktr.ee/videogamecream
The game key has been provided by the developer and/or publisher.
